title: Colosseum 1.1.9
summary: Explore cross-media Universes, browse the redesigned Vault, and manage extensions in the native House.

highlights.title: Your fourth world
highlights.body: Explore franchise banners, cross-media shelves and a separate Tributes carousel.

highlights.title: Sail all four seas
highlights.body: Explore interactive atlases from East Blue to the Final Sea, with arc previews and local artwork.

highlights.title: Your local media library
highlights.body: Browse poster rails, folder breadcrumbs and detail sheets in the redesigned Vault.

highlights.title: Welcome to the House
highlights.body: Manage extension tiles and move between Chain, House and Store.

highlights.title: Resume and search reliably
highlights.body: Resume local comics at their saved reading position and search PDF text in Reader2.

highlights.title: First-party Windows updates
highlights.body: Signed update discovery now uses getcolosseum.world. Install 1.1.9 manually once to migrate from 1.1.8. Linux updates remain manual.
